h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Bokaro

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Bokaro

c: Bokaro Steel City is a planned township in Jharkhand built around one of the country's big steel plants, and its sectors have parks, schools and sports grounds laid out from the start. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor gym equipment in Bokaro to schools, township and civic departments, housing societies, colleges and private campuses. The machines come from our factory in Vasai, about 1,450 km away, by road.

Schools are among our most frequent buyers in steel towns, and an open gym at a school needs a different plan from one in a park. It has to suit students in the senior classes, it will be used in groups during games periods, and teachers need to see the whole area at a glance. The climate on the Chota Nagpur plateau brings hot summers, a good monsoon and cool winters, so frames are galvanised and seats are roto-moulded plastic.

items.q: Are outdoor gym machines suitable for school students?
items.a: They suit senior students and adults. Younger children should use play equipment instead. We can plan a school ground with a separate zone for each and mark both on the layout.

items.q: Can teachers supervise an open gym easily?
items.a: Yes, if the machines are grouped in one compact block. We draw the layout so a teacher standing at one side can see every station.
Yes. We dispatch from Vasai by road and install with our own team or a dealer covering eastern India, grouted or self-standing depending on your ground.
